image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vintage, heavily rusted cast-iron sad iron (flatiron) resting on a textured purple fabric surface. The iron features a solid, looped metal handle attached to the top of a thick, wedge-shaped body. The soleplate has a distinctive scalloped or wavy edge design near the front. The entire object is covered in significant orange-brown rust and corrosion, indicating age and lack of use. The background is a plain, out-of-focus cream-colored wall.
